direct_wallet_lane.entry: Use the first point-in-time executable market observation at or immediately after the verified source-wallet buy transaction; never hindsight pricing.
direct_wallet_lane.exit_primary: Exit the copied position when the source wallet makes a verified on-chain sell of the same exact mint, proportional to the source wallet's sold fraction when measurable.
direct_wallet_lane.post_exit_tracking: Continue marking each token after simulated exit so the experiment can measure whether exits were early, late, or protective.

truth_rules.forward_calls: Only recommendations or source-wallet swaps first observed after activation may count as simulated forward entries.
truth_rules.historical_calls: Earlier calls are retained only as retrospective benchmark observations and never booked as verified forward P&L.
truth_rules.identity: Exact contract/mint and chain must be verified before a price entry can be booked.
truth_rules.entry: Use first verifiable public/on-chain timestamp and the first point-in-time market observation at or after that timestamp; never hindsight-low or later claimed call price.
truth_rules.comparison: Record whether Wallet500 detected the same exact token before, at, or after the source-wallet/public-call event.
truth_rules.isolation: This cohort cannot promote tokens into Wallet500 production or weaken liquidity/exact-pair/holder-cluster safety gates.
truth_rules.real_money: No real-money trade is claimed or executed by this experiment unless a separate authorized wallet executor is connected and transaction hashes are recorded.

notes: Direct-wallet lane tracks the source wallet independently from public calls. +200% means 3.0x entry; +300% means 4.0x entry. The 3x rule is the primary candidate and 4x is retained as a shadow comparator.
